## 简体中文

### 修复

- 将 macOS 托管 DNS 前端从特权端口 `53` 移到 `20554`，代理核心 DNS 入口仍使用 `20553`，避免常见系统解析器冲突且不改变托管 DNS 路由边界。
- 新建本地配置的默认端口改为 SOCKS `20580` 和 HTTP `20581`。运行启动现在会拒绝被占用或重复的代理端口并给出可操作提示；核心 DNS 入口继续同时校验 TCP 和 UDP 可用性。
- Windows 没有可用 IPv6 路由时禁用生成的 FakeIPv6 响应。
- 在生成配置刷新期间保留 sing-box FakeIP 缓存状态。
- 将批量代理选择输出限定到当前重启操作。

### 兼容性

- 现有配置保留明确保存的端口并可继续编辑；只有新建配置自动使用新的代理默认端口。

### 验证

- 在真实 Apple Silicon Mac 上验证系统解析器使用 `127.0.0.1:20554`、核心 DNS 使用 `20553`，并能通过 `20580`/`20581` 正常进行 SOCKS/HTTP 出站。
- 确认迁移活动配置后释放旧监听端口 `53`、`1053`、`1080` 和 `1081`。
- GitHub Actions 验证源码，并为 Linux、Windows、macOS 的 amd64 和 arm64 生成带来源证明的 bundle 与 CycloneDX SBOM。

- [完整更新记录](https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v2.0.8-beta.1...v2.0.8-beta.2)

## English

### Fixed

- Moved the managed macOS DNS frontend from privileged port `53` to `20554`, while keeping the proxy-core DNS ingress on `20553`. This avoids common system resolver conflicts without changing the managed DNS routing boundary.
- Changed new local-profile defaults to SOCKS `20580` and HTTP `20581`. Runtime startup now rejects occupied or duplicate proxy ports with actionable guidance; the core DNS ingress continues to validate both TCP and UDP availability.
- Disabled generated FakeIPv6 responses on Windows when no usable IPv6 route exists.
- Preserved sing-box FakeIP cache state across generated configuration refreshes.
- Scoped bulk proxy selection output to the active restart operation.

### Compatibility

- Existing profiles keep their explicitly saved ports and remain editable. Only newly created profiles receive the new proxy defaults automatically.

### Verification

- Verified on a real Apple Silicon Mac with the system resolver at `127.0.0.1:20554`, core DNS on `20553`, and successful SOCKS/HTTP egress through `20580`/`20581`.
- Confirmed legacy listeners `53`, `1053`, `1080`, and `1081` were released after migrating the active profile.
- GitHub Actions verified the source and produced attested bundles plus CycloneDX SBOMs for Linux, Windows, and macOS on amd64 and arm64.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v2.0.8-beta.1...v2.0.8-beta.2
